shadows.name: brutalist-hard-shadow
shadows.purpose: Tactile offset shadow on rest state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #f43f5e; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #fb7185; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000000; }

narrative.overview: SurSangeet combines a tactile hi-fi hardware console with a dark studio atmosphere. The visual identity reflects physical audio gear: dark metal enclosures, crimson LED indicators, mechanical sliders, and a central spinning vinyl turntable with a dynamic tonearm pickup needle.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Brutalism: 2px solid borders (#232736), sharp corners, and 4px offset hard drop-shadows (#040507).
Signal Red Accents: Rose crimson (#f43f5e) reserved for primary action triggers and active play states.
Grain & Micro-Grooves: Radial noise backdrop with authentic vinyl micro-groove rings.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Crimson (#f43f5e) is strictly reserved for active audio state indicators and primary execution triggers. It must occupy ≤ 15% of any given view.

dos: Do maintain sharp 2px borders (#232736) and hard offset shadows (#040507).
Do uppercase technical metadata text with Space Grotesk font.
donts: Don't use soft rounded border radii (rounded-xl) on cards or buttons.
